buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Product Specifications · The computer shall strictly conform to the technical specifications mentioned in the GeM order/bid. · The supplied equipment must be brand new, unused and not refurbished or reconditioned. · All components, including processor, RAM, SSD/HDD, monitor, keyboard and mouse, shall be as per the a pproved configuration. 2. Delivery · The supplier shall deliver the computers to the consignee's designated location within the delivery period specified in the GeM contract. · Transportation, packing, insurance and delivery charges shall be borne by the supplier. · The supplier shall ensure safe delivery without any physical damage.

3. Installation and Commissioning · Installation and commissioning shall be carried out by the supplier/OEM wherever applicable. · Necessary drivers, operating system and system configuration shall be completed. · The supplier shall ensure that all computers are in proper working condition. 4. Warranty · The supplied computers shall carry a minimum THREE-years onsite warranty or the higher warranty perio d specified in the GeM catalogue/contract. · Warranty shall cover hardware defects and manufacturing defects. · The supplier shall provide the OEM warranty certificate. · The supplier shall provide necessary after-sales support during the warranty period. 5. Inspection and Acceptance · All computers shall be inspected by the consignee after delivery. · The serial numbers and configurations shall be verified through the OEM website. · The consignee reserves the right to reject damaged, defective, refurbished or non-compliant products. · Acceptance shall be subject to satisfactory inspection, installation and testing. 6. Replacement of Defective Items · Any defective or damaged computer supplied shall be repaired or replaced by the supplier without additi onal cost. · Replacement shall be completed within the time specified by the purchaser. 7. Operating System and Software · The computer shall be supplied with a genuine, properly licensed operating system windows 11 and MS o ffice specified in the GeM order. · All necessary software licences and activation details shall be provided. · No pirated or unauthorized software shall be installed. 8. Payment Terms · Payment shall be released only after satisfactory receipt and acceptance of the supplied computers. · Payment shall be processed through the GeM portal as per applicable Government of India and GeM pay ment procedures. · Statutory deductions, wherever applicable, shall be made as per rules. 9. Liquidated Damages - In case of delay in delivery beyond the stipulated period, liquidated damages shall be imposed as per th e applicable GeM General Terms and Conditions and contract provisions. 10. Compliance with Government Rules · The supplier shall comply with applicable Government of India procurement rules, GeM General Terms an d Conditions Make in India provisions and other applicable guidelines. · The supplier shall submit all necessary documents and certificates required under the GeM bid/contract. .
